[u]Micros Chips Industrialization Initiative[/u][/b]

Audaraiun has initiated funding for Micros Chip's $198.6 billion industrialization initiative aimed at transforming the chip industry. Comprehensive plans have been made to establish funding for research and education in robotics across educational institutions in Audaraiun. This will facilitate construction efforts that will enhance chip production by adding advanced semiconductor fabrication plants and dedicated research and development centers focusing on next-generation chip design and manufacturing technologies. Emperor Kursian Audour has advocated for research programs and education in robotics and semiconductors at both school and university levels throughout Audaraiun. The Kingdom of Audaraiun is committed to providing substantial funding to support emerging companies and actively encourages private and foreign partnerships to invest.

The Robotics and Advancement Research of Audaraiun is concentrated on developing technological infrastructure, improving advanced robotics for manufacturing processes, and creating AI-driven chip design tools to lessen reliance on foreign chip supplies. Emperor Kursian Audour's vision is to bolster national security while fostering a self-sustaining technological ecosystem that will boost Audaraiun into cultivating a world-class semiconductor industry.
[/i]

[i][b]Operation Reichasku Wolf
[/b]
Emperor Kursian Audour ordered Reichasku Wolf in a careful attempt to block any ship, vessel, or plane out of Yourika Island. Troops of the Audaraiun Army have planned to expand and conquer Yourika Island. The Kingdom of Audaraiun has ordered the Humanization of the populated Non-Human species that lives on Yourika Island. The Non-Human Species outside of  Audaraiun have viewed this creature as Half Man Half Beast that habited in Yourika Island centuries ago. Now the Audaraiun Kingdom wanted to establish itself as a colony, planning to get rid of Non-Human Species and establish a Humanize settlement. Emperor Kursian Audour has a plan for the integration of Non-Human Species in Audaraiun by forces.

[b]WestAuria[/b]
Here Lives with Emperor Kursian Audour, announced the declaration of integration of Yourika Island.

Emperor Kursian Audour has announced in his following words Dear people of Audaraiun Its time for us to coupar the beast who threatened our Humanited Kind, now is the time to expand our lands in the far west and fight for peace and our fatherlands. More than 450,000 Active specialist troops of Audaraiun have been sent in forces by masses to annex Yourika Island. With outnumbering forces, Emperor Kursian Audour ordered Yourika Island to lay down its forces and jointed part with the Audaraiun Kingdom. In a few hours, the Yourika Prime Minister came with a response that they wouldnt be annexed by the Audaraiun Kingdom. Emperor Kursian Audour was in range to carry the attack by opening the Navy's fires with incoming air attacks in the city. In 2-3 Hours, the carry-out attack was ordered to be stopped with Audaraiun forces landing in the cities. Civilians and Army Troops defend the city with some attacks to push back Audaraiun forces but with outnumbering troops over well Yourika to push back. In just 1 hour of fighting in city squares, Yourika Island took a total of losses. More than 2,708 Yourika Island have died in caring attacks by the Audaraiun Kingdom. The Audaraiun lost with a total of 514 troops dead in the acts. With the city over-well, the Audaraiun forces have led to Yourika Island to surround as well as signing annexes of Audaraiun Kingdom. With the capitulation of Yourika Island, surrendered all control to the Audaraiun Kingdom. 

[b]The Aftermath[/b]

With the fall of Yourika Island, Emperor Kursian Audour prompted the lower class to discriminate against Non-Human Species by lessening their power and allowing Human Settlers to gain more power over Non-Human Species. But do allow some freedom for Non-Human Species, as well as not allowing no discriminate hate speech or even hate crimes to be committed by splitting both communities. To ensure peace and loyalty on the island. With the Audaraiun Kingdom having more power over the island, only humans take business and trade ports by force. Any rebels will lead to jail or death by order of the Audaraiun Kingdom.
